ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.
   B. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)

   A. Pollute rivers deliberately

----
